description: This PHP source file defines the EditTimesheetController class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. The class manages the rendering and access control of the edit timesheet view in the HRM system, utilizing traits for authentication, service access, and user role management. It processes incoming requests to determine if the current user has permission to edit a specific timesheet and prepares a Vue component for rendering.

classes.name: EditTimesheetController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the 'edit timesheet' view, including pre-render setup and access control checks.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering the edit timesheet view, setting properties like timesheet ID and user ownership status based on the request and fetched timesheet data.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Determines if the current user has permission to edit the specified timesheet, preventing editing of approved timesheets by non-authorized users.
